summary: Business Insider reported that Oracle began a new round of layoffs on September 14, 2026, with affected employees and an internal termination email confirming the cuts; the publication tied the round to Oracle's previously reported plan to reduce payroll while taking on substantial debt to fund AI data center infrastructure.
evidenceQuote: Business Insider last month reported that the company had drawn up plans for a new round of job cuts to reduce payroll as it racks up billions in debt to fund AI infrastructure.
notes: Oracle's termination notice cited only current business needs and broader organizational change, not AI. The AI connection is therefore journalist-reported and spending/reorganization-linked rather than a company-stated AI layoff rationale. The affected headcount was not disclosed; Business Insider reported that planned cuts reached double-digit percentages on some teams, according to an internal document.

sources.name: Business Insider Africa
sources.quote: Oracle has started a new round of layoffs, according to three people impacted and an email shared with Business Insider.
